PROJECT

Personal Project — IDEA

01The name LUNE is inspired by the French word for moon. I chose this name because it represents simplicity, elegance, and timelessness, with a subtle French influence for a pastry and coffee brand. It is short, memorable, and distinctive.
02The LUNE logo is inspired by two essential elements: the shape of a croissant and a coffee bean, representing the brand’s two main offerings. I combined them into a simple yet meaningful symbol without unnecessary visual details.
03Deep Burgundy (#320000) brings elegance and warmth, Warm Cream (#FFEFD1) adds a soft, sweet touch, Deep Navy Blue (#000E8E) adds contrast and boldness, and White (#FFFFFF) keeps the identity clean and balanced.

LUNE — Pastry & Coffee Restaurant

CroissantSymbolizes pastries, warmth, and expertise in offering bakery products.
Coffee BeanRepresents coffee as an essential part of the restaurant’s identity.

Deep Burgundy · #320000Primary — elegance, exclusivity, distinct character.

Warm Cream · #FFEFD1Secondary — the softness of baked dough.

Deep Royal Blue · #000E8EAccent — contrast and a modern touch.

Pure White · #FFFFFFNeutral — clean, balanced space.
